project_type: pnpm monorepo with TypeScript Lambda functions, AWS CDK infrastructure, and Python AgentCore agent
build_system: pnpm workspace, tsc for TypeScript packages, uv for Python agent
test_framework: vitest for functions package (src/**/*.test.ts pattern), vitest mocks with vi.mock
build_command: pnpm -r build (runs tsc in each package)
verification_instructions: 1. Run pnpm install to ensure deps. 2. Run pnpm typecheck for TypeScript checking. 3. Run pnpm test for unit tests.
setup_instructions: pnpm install at root to install all workspace dependencies
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - can install npm packages freely. Node.js 22, pnpm available. No Docker needed for validation.
contribution_requirements: CI runs pnpm typecheck on PRs. TypeScript strict mode enabled. Tests use vitest with mocking.
key_patterns: CDK constructs in packages/infra/lib/constructs/, each exports a class. Stack in stacks/homework-print-bot-stack.ts composes all constructs. Lambda handlers in packages/functions/src/<feature>/handler.ts. Shared utils in packages/functions/src/shared/. Tests colocated as *.test.ts. ApiConstruct uses NodejsFunction bundling. Agent entrypoint.py uses render_to_png which falls back to HTML bytes when Playwright unavailable.
directory_structure: Root: pnpm-workspace.yaml, tsconfig.base.json, package.json. packages/functions/ - TypeScript Lambda handlers (webhook). packages/infra/ - CDK infra with constructs/ and stacks/ dirs. packages/agent/ - Python AgentCore agent with src/ containing print_generator, grading, adaptive_learning modules.
